composition: Twill-weave cotton fabric, 308 g/m², supplied by Jiangsu Shayin Group
TGA_specimen_preparation: Prepared fabric aliquot of approximately 5 mg in an open alumina pan. General sample conditioning: 25 ± 2 °C and 65% humidity for 24 h. Cutting/grinding and gas flow not reported.

title: Optimization of a Phosphorus-doped Silica Sol Coating on Cotton Fabrics
journal: Proceedings of the 2nd Annual International Conference on Advanced Material Engineering (AME 2016), pp 1047-1053
sample_state: cot_Si, initial silica hydrosol and HDTMS treated cotton
treatment_chemistry: Methyltrimethoxysilane (MTMOS), tetraethoxysilane (TEOS), and hexadecyltrimethoxysilane (HDTMS), with CTAC/Tween 60 surfactants; cot_Si is the phosphorus-free silica hydrosol treatment
treatment_method: Disperse MTMOS in 100 mL distilled water with surfactants using a FA25 FLUKO disperser. Acid-hydrolyze for 4 h, then add TEOS dropwise and react for 2 h; modify the sol with HDTMS. Source optimization identifies 1.5 g MTMOS, 2.5 g TEOS, CTAC:Tween 60 = 2:3, surfactant dosage 0.9% (denominator unstated), pH 3 and 30 °C synthesis. cot_Si is explicitly pure silica hydrosol, without ammonium biphosphate; HDTMS amount and the exact cot_Si-specific quantities are not separately stated. Pad at 2 kg/cm² nip pressure, dry at 80 °C for 5 min and cure for 5 min; optimization captions specify 130 °C. Condition at 25 ± 2 °C and 65% humidity for 24 h. No durability washing reported.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Same cot_Si cotton fabric as the TG row in original Table 1. LOI dimensions, number of repetitions and uncertainty not reported; three repeats in methods apply to contact angle only.
TG_locator: Original Table 1, printed p 1052/PDF p 6: cot_Si Tmax 338 °C, residue at 600 °C 11.4%, residue at Tmax 41.4%; printed p 1051 thermal analysis corroborates DTG peak 338 °C. T5 47 °C kept raw because below stated 50 °C scan start.
LOI_locator: Original Table 1, printed p 1052/PDF p 6: cot_Si LOI 17.4%.
conditions_locator: Original Experimental, printed p 1048/PDF p 2: TGA and LOI methods, fabric and coating. Optimization figure captions pp 1049-1051 identify recipe and curing conditions.
pairing_evidence: One row of original Table 1 explicitly pairs cot_Si TGA and measured LOI. The preceding thermal-analysis paragraph defines cot_Si as pure-silica-hydrosol treated cotton. No wash series applies. Same-numbered states in related journal paper are held from duplicate counting, not treated as additional measurements.
source_location: Complete seven-page original proceedings text read from indexed official PDF. Direct PDF bytes and screenshots returned gateway/cache errors, so no proceedings pixel or document-hash claim. Related four-page journal original was downloaded solely for reuse/conflict audit.
limitations: Only the silica-only state is proposed. Related journal Table 2 repeats LOI 17.4 and Table 1 repeats R600 11.4 for silica-only fabric, but its other state LOIs conflict with the proceedings or internally, so control and phosphorus-treated states remain held. No journal values or missing recipe details are imported. Exact HDTMS dosage and table-specific cot_Si recipe quantities are unstated. Source T5 47 °C lies below the stated 50 °C scan start, so canonical T5 is blank. Proceedings cot_Si/P Tmax 262 °C in table conflicts with 226 °C prose and is withheld; this does not affect silica-only Tmax 338. Prose incorrectly describes 34.0/41.4/77.8 as maximum weight-loss rates; Table 1 labels them residues at Tmax, which is the retained meaning. All MCC peaks and heat-release metrics from the journal are excluded from TGA. No graph estimates, source SD or new replicate counts invented.
